title: onboard-astralite-7b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Sasha Patel
release_notes:
- Onboarded AstraLite-7B v1.0: model metadata, recommended instance and kernel mappings, and performance profiles.
- Added changelog automation integration so new model onboards create draft release notes and perf summaries.
- Docs: short model card and usage example added.
description: Motivation: Add AstraLite-7B v1.0 to the model registry with complete metadata, performance profiles for our standard GPU families, and wire it into the automated changelog/release notes pipeline. This PR includes: checklist items for validation, CI tests, and documentation updates. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata YAML (parameters, tokenizer, license, source) - [x] Generate performance profiles (latency/throughput across T4/A10/A100 profiles with seq lengths: 64/256/1024) - [x] Hook onboarding into changelog automation to generate draft release notes and perf summary - [x] Add small integration test exercising registry load + perf profile lookup - [x] Add model card doc and quickstart example Notes: AstraLite is a 7B encoder-decoder variant optimized for inference with grouped-kernel support. We include recommended quantization (int8-ptq) profile and fallback kernels for older GPU types. Linear/PM context: ENG-5421 (model onboarding flow), PM-2334 (product announcement coordination). Testing: local perf runs (perf-canary) and CI unit tests validate metadata schema and perf profile parsing. Risk: low; changes are additive to registry and automation. Rollout: merged to main after approvals and CI green. See files_changed for details.

Sasha Patel: Added tests/test_onboard_astralite.py to validate profile keys and schema
Ethan Zhang: Approved after CI green; noted that changelog automation needs to include perf table for release notes

changelog_actions: Updated automate_changelog.py to detect new model metadata under model_registry/models/* and append a perf-summary block to draft release notes. The script now emits a structured markdown table with median latency and p95 for each tested GPU/seq combo and creates a linked perf artifact in CI. Backwards compatible: if no performance_profiles.json is present, the script emits a 'perf data not available' placeholder.
notes_for_ops: No infra changes. Perf-canary config added for AstraLite-7B to CI perf ladder. Recommend a one-off canary run in staging with representative traffic before public announcement.
